scripts.build: npm run build -w @wired-square/tokens && npm run build -w @wired-square/kit && npm run build -w @wired-square/mcp-bridge
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run gates && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run fixture
scripts.gates: node scripts/forbidden-names.mjs && node scripts/no-colour.mjs && node scripts/theme-css.mjs --check
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/tokens && tsc -p packages/tokens/test && tsc -p packages/kit && tsc -p packages/kit/test && tsc -p packages/mcp-bridge && tsc -p packages/mcp-bridge/test && tsc -p fixtures/consumer
scripts.test: npm test -w @wired-square/tokens && npm test -w @wired-square/kit && npm test -w @wired-square/mcp-bridge && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
